messages:
jamie: Alert from telemetry: allocation drift for rollout r-7423. Canary was supposed to get 10% but observed 39.6% over a 15m window. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/r-7423
aria: saw that. Logs show routing fallback triggered — per-route quota pool for baseline hit zero, so requests were routed to canary via overflow policy.
mike: confirming: routing-policy v2 has "overflow_to_canary" enabled for bursts. That flag was intended for short bursts but it interacts poorly with per-route quotas and sticky assignment.
sara: quick numbers: assigned counts in last 15m -> baseline=610, canary=3890. Expected approx baseline~4500 / canary~500 given configured 90/10 split. Observed CTR diff not significant yet, but sample ratio violation obvious.
jamie: root cause hypothesis: quota exhaustion from an older global token-bucket config + a client retry pattern. Also spotted change to client header "x-sampling-mode" that bypasses assignment layer for some clients.
aria: I pushed a hotfix to staging that disables overflow_to_canary. Suggest we pause the canary (set to 0%) and revert the flag in prod until we confirm quotas behave.
mike: operational options: (1) immediate pause (0%) and invalidate run, (2) reduce canary to target 10% and extend test to reach required N, (3) continue as-is and accept sample ratio mismatch (not recommended).
sara: stats note: to detect a 2% absolute lift at alpha=0.05 we need ~30k users per arm. Current counts (canary ~3.9k, baseline ~0.6k) are underpowered and biased. Any A/B inference now is unreliable.
jamie: recommendation: abort/mark this run invalid, roll back overflow flag, and re-run a controlled canary with deterministic routing at 10% and a 48h collection window. We'll treat current data as contaminated.
aria: I'll open a console guard to block enabling "overflow_to_canary" on prod and ship the patch. CC @oncall.
mike: also propose adding an SRM (sample ratio monitoring) guard in the rollout controller: reject/auto-pause rollouts where observed assignment deviates >5 percentage points from the configured split for >5 minutes.
jamie: agreed. Can someone draft a short postmortem paragraph and update rollout docs about quota interactions and the overflow flag?
sara: I'll run an inverse-propensity reweight (IPW) to see if directionality changes; will share corrected effect estimates and an exploratory table in ~2h. This helps stakeholders understand contamination severity.
ci-bot: deploy 1856.1235 -> disabled overflow_to_canary in prod. :white_check_mark:
jamie: thanks everyone. Action items: aria - PR + console guard; mike - create SRM check ticket and timeline; sara - reweight analysis; jamie - notify PMs, mark run invalid, and update incident tracker. I'll update thread as items close. :thumbsup:
